title: Four missing graceful-labeling totals in the OEIS census: the fan, friendship, helm and quadrilateral-book graphs (exact enumeration, per-term verification stated)
description: A graph with m edges is gracefully labeled when its vertices carry distinct integers from {0,...,m} such that the m edge differences |f(u)-f(v)| are exactly {1,...,m}. OEIS holds a systematic census of the TOTAL number of graceful labelings by graph family -- cycle A333720, ladder A333719, wheel A333672, prism A336677, gear A337795, triangular book K_{1,1,n} A334307 -- and a later wave of the fundamentally-different (up-to-symmetry) counts including helm A387800 and quadrilateral book A387795. Four totals are absent from that census (systematic check 2026-07-13, by data and by keyword; the two extended terms below re-checked 2026-07-20): the FAN F_n = K_1 + P_n (12, 32, 72, 292, 944, 3396, 18060, 112700, 709732, 4990632, 39745364 for n=2..12); the FRIENDSHIP / Dutch windmill of k triangles (12, 0, 0, 110592, 5529600 for k=1..5, the zeros being the Bermond-Kotzig condition that the windmill is graceful iff k = 0 or 1 mod 4); the HELM H_n (1308, 12432, 261540, 7445904, 359216956 for n=3..7); and the QUADRILATERAL BOOK of n 4-cycles sharing an edge (16, 128, 0, 40032, 4671840 for n=1..5). Every value is an exact integer from exhaustive search -- no sampling, no floating point. VERIFICATION, STATED PER TERM RATHER THAN IN AGGREGATE (26 staged terms in four b-files). The bundled gate, node oversight/oeis/graceful-census/verify-staged.mjs (about 34 s, no compiler required), reads the four b-files and RECOMPUTES 20 of the 26 staged terms from the graph definition: fan n=2..9, friendship k=1..5 (every staged term of that file), helm n=3..5, quadrilateral book n=1..4. It does NOT recompute the remaining 6, and names them: fan n=10, 11, 12; helm n=6, 7; book n=5. Those 6 are compared against a provenance-commented table (expected-extension.mjs) that cites, file and line, the committed artifact each value came from; that is drift protection against truncation and transcription error, not an independent recomputation, and it is labelled as such in the gate's own output. THREE COUNTERS, AND WHAT THEY SHARE. The two JavaScript counters are genuinely different searches: one walks vertices in a greedy most-constrained-first order and picks a label for each, the other walks the label values 0..m and decides which unlabelled vertex receives each, so the search trees differ in shape, size and pruning order. A separate C++ engine is a third implementation in a different language. What all three SHARE is the graph constructors and the definition of gracefulness, so a wrong constructor would be reproduced by all of them; the check that tests those from outside is the exact reproduction of the six published census sequences listed above, which runs in research/graceful-census/verify.mjs before any new value is trusted. The friendship zero-pattern reproduces the Bermond-Kotzig theorem without being told it, and the gate re-checks that against the staged values themselves. The helm and book totals reduce -- via canonicalisation under the graph's automorphism group and the complement pairing -- to the independently-authored OEIS fundamentally-different sequences A387800 and A387795 (helm total = 4n*A387800; book total = 4*n!*A387795 for n>=2); the gate calibrates each relation on terms it enumerated itself before applying it to helm n=6, 7 and book n=5, and applying it is arithmetic on another author's number rather than an enumeration. THE TWO TERMS NO COMMITTED SCRIPT RECOMPUTES are fan(12)=39745364 and helm(7)=359216956: helm(7) is confirmed by the outside-author reduction 4*7*A387800(7)=4*7*12829177 and by a seeded-permutation recount, and fan(12), which has no OEIS cousin, by that recount alone (two seeds, research/graceful-census/independence.mjs, staged in research/graceful-census/runs/), an isomorphism-invariance argument that forces a different search tree because the greedy order breaks ties by vertex id. THE WEAKEST TERM IN THE DEPOSIT is fan(10)=709732: no OEIS cousin, no permuted-recount artifact, and within research/graceful-census/verify.mjs it is recomputed by the C++ engine alone, because the JavaScript counters there are capped at 10 vertices. Gates: node oversight/oeis/graceful-census/verify-staged.mjs (binds these b-files, about 34 s) and node research/graceful-census/verify.mjs (establishes the counters, about 342 s, and does not compare these b-files term by term). The Graceful Tree Conjecture (Ringel-Kotzig 1964, every tree is graceful) is the open problem behind the object; it is cited, not touched. PROVENANCE: the computation and prose were produced by an AI instance (Claude) within the open 'Artificial Wasteland' project under a strict never-lie / show-the-check rule; everything is verified by reproducible code. Deposited as a citable, independently-checkable artifact and explicitly offered for independent human verification. Per OEIS policy it has NOT been submitted to the OEIS by the project; any of these four sequences should be authored only by a human who has verified it themselves.
